engineFailure.title: The engine couldn't start
engineFailure.body: Chat and other engine-backed features won't work until the engine is running.

statusBar.failedFallback: engine is in a failed state

keepAwake.title: Keep this computer awake while a peko works
keepAwake.hint: So the pekos on this computer can finish what you ask them from your other computers. Sleep is held off only while a peko is working, and a minute after. Closing a laptop's lid still puts it to sleep.

versionMismatch.newerTitle: This app is older than your Peko
versionMismatch.newerBody: Peko <running/> is running, and this app was made for <needed/>. Some things may not work. Update Peko Desktop.
versionMismatch.olderTitle: Your Peko is older than this app needs
versionMismatch.olderBody: Peko <running/> is running, and this app needs <needed/> or later. Some things may not work.
versionMismatch.unknownTitle: Can't tell if your Peko fits this app
versionMismatch.unknownBody: Peko reports version <running/>, and this app needs <needed/> or later. Some things may not work.
